items.title: How do underwater tunnels not flood?
items.summary: Britain and France dug toward each other under the sea and met only 36 cm apart. The Channel Tunnel has about 37.9 km under the sea and sits roughly 45 m below the seabed on average, cut through chalk marl. The main rail tunnel machines on the French side weighed about 1,100 tonnes. Crews dug from both coasts and the service tunnel bores met on December 1, 1990. Idea: Cleo Abram. items.summary: Release: llm 0.37.3 A bug fix release for LLM , mainly to cover a problem with the most recent Homebrew package of the software. Homebrew now ships the latest SQLite, 3.54.1 , which includes a fix that broke LLM's logging code . Short version: in SQLite 3.54.0 the following SQL: select json_object('a', (select json_array(1))) Returns this: {"a":[1]} But in 3.54.1 the same query returns this: {"a":"[1]"} According to D.
